build_spec.purpose: Automate asset maintenance tasks, provide real-time monitoring, and predictive maintenance insights to reduce downtime and increase overall asset efficiency
build_spec.target_user: Facilities managers, maintenance teams, and asset owners

core_capabilities.description: Use machine learning algorithms to analyze sensor data and predict potential asset failures
Track asset performance and health in real-time, enabling swift response to issues
Create and assign work orders to maintenance teams based on predicted or detected issues
Track and manage spare parts and materials, ensuring timely availability for maintenance tasks

workflow_steps.detail: Collect and process data from various sources, including sensors, maintenance records, and operator feedback
Apply machine learning algorithms to analyze data, detect patterns, and predict potential issues
Send alerts and notifications to maintenance teams and stakeholders in case of predicted or detected issues
Automatically generate and assign work orders to maintenance teams based on predicted or detected issues

integrations.purpose: Integrate with existing CMMS to access maintenance records and schedules
Integrate with ERP to access inventory management and procurement systems
Integrate with SCADA to access real-time sensor data and control systems

suggested_tech_stack.database: Time-series database (e.g., InfluxDB) and relational database (e.g., MySQL)
integrations: API-based integrations with CMMS, ERP, and SCADA systems

build_spec.what_competitors_have: Workato offers an automation platform with AI-powered workflow automation, while Automation Anywhere provides an RPA platform with AI-powered automation capabilities
build_spec.our_differentiation: Our AssetGenie agent offers a unique combination of predictive maintenance, real-time monitoring, and automated work order generation, tailored to the specific needs of asset maintenance teams

competitor_summary.workato: Offers an automation platform with AI-powered workflow automation, but lacks specific focus on asset maintenance
competitor_summary.automation_anywhere: Provides an RPA platform with AI-powered automation capabilities, but has limited capabilities in predictive maintenance and real-time monitoring
competitor_summary.others: Other competitors, such as UiPath and Blue Prism, offer RPA platforms with varying degrees of AI-powered automation capabilities, but may not have the same level of focus on asset maintenance as our proposed solution
